page.layout: One page of text, two columns of running text in one block, with no margin notes and no notes below the text. Running head at the top centre. Page number at the top right. Verse set in italic lines, centred, between the paragraphs. Bottom right: a catchword-like mark "gendi," is the last line of the text, not a catchword.

main_text.p: electus fuit Moderator Nicolsonus, paulò ante titu-lo & beneficio tenus factus Episcopus Caledonius, quem ufurpationis hujus feriam licet feram incef-fisse poenitentiam referunt. In cujus rei fidem circumferuntur versus non illepidi, compositi à Theologo magni nominis D. Lindesio, Brechinensê primum, dein Edenburgensi Episcopo. ipsi proxima affinitate juncto; qui, quæ præsens audiit profa, sic metro constrinxisse fertur:

p.i: Et medicum accerfi sedulo quisque jubet
Sed dare solamen nemo, dare nemo salutem
Te præter, potuit, Rex Iacobe, mihi.
Quae corpus gravat atque animam tantum eximé mitrae
Huic caput: hujus onus me premit & perimit,

main_text.p: Paftorum quidam inviti (qui sub poena perduellionis cogebantur) decretum hujus conventus, de presbyteriorum seu Claffium perpetuis moderatoribus, admiserunt; sub certis tamen conditionibus, donec ea de re plenius, in Synodo nationali libera disputiretur: Alii vero qui admittere nullatenus voluerunt, duriter tractati; quibusdam in exilium ejectis, aliis carceri mancipatis, nondum tamen arcem caufæ obtinuerunt; ideoque huc jam omnes conatus collimant, ut jurisdictionem Ecclesiasticam plenè obtinerent.

In hunc finem Menfe Februario anni 1610. quam Ecclesiarum consensu se nunquam adepturos noverant, jurisdictionem in fratres compresbyteros à Rege obtinent, sub titulo Commissariorum Regis in jurisdictione Ecclesiastica seu judicum celse Commissionis, qua armantur potestate exauctorandi ministros, suspensionis censuram irrogandi, excommunicationem decernendi, & ad ferendam sententiam aut latam denunciandam, quemvis Miniftrum co-gendi,

page.notes: The scan is one printed page, page 12. The page number and running head are as printed. The verse lines are set in italic and were transcribed as printed. Doubtful readings: "Nicolsonus" and "Brechinensê" (the printed accent may be a mark, not a letter), "Claffium", "eximé mitrae", "perimit", and "Miniftrum" are all read from the scan with some uncertainty. Several words in the second column (e.g. "disputiretur", "conatus", "Commissionis") are partly obscured by show-through and were read as best I could. The heading "gendi," at the foot is the printed end of a word broken across the page, so it stays in the text. Show-through from the other side of the leaf is ignored.
